command_sightline.name: Command Sightline
command_sightline.rule: Primary seat must face the room's main entry point. No back to the door. Visual authority over the full space. Float the primary seating minimum 60cm from the wall to establish an authoritative command position.

surface_hierarchy.name: Surface Hierarchy
surface_hierarchy.rule: Every horizontal surface has one designated function. In compact rooms, this is critical — surfaces bleed immediately. Secondary items must go vertical only, preserving the primary focus.

invisible_threshold.name: Invisible Threshold
invisible_threshold.rule: A rug defines a zone as firmly as a partition — without reducing physical space. Position all primary seating legs fully within the rug's perimeter to firmly anchor the visual zone.

ortho_axial.name: Ortho-Axial Alignment
ortho_axial.rule: All furniture aligns to the room's primary axis. Diagonal placement is prohibited. In a square room, you must create this axis artificially with the longest furniture piece.

social_gravity.name: Social Gravity
social_gravity.rule: Arrange primary seating in a conversational circle. No TV focus. Seating is focused entirely on social interaction, drawing people together organically in cozy configurations.

soft_threshold.name: Soft Threshold
soft_threshold.rule: Use soft organic textiles and layered rugs to define shared boundaries without creating harsh barriers. Soft textures create subconscious safety and spatial comfort.

shared_radius.name: Shared Radius
shared_radius.rule: Provide a shared circulation zone with wide clearances. In family environments, maintain clear pathways to prevent physical collision and reduce friction.

acoustic_softening.name: Acoustic Softening
acoustic_softening.rule: Use textured wall panels, thick curtains, and soft rugs to absorb vocal frequencies, allowing quiet private conversations even in a bustling multi-generational shared room.

monastic_isolation.name: Monastic Isolation
monastic_isolation.rule: Create an isolated work or reading nook facing away from traffic paths. Provide absolute visual and acoustic privacy for deep concentration.

focused_sightline.name: Focused Sightline
focused_sightline.rule: Ensure the primary seat is oriented away from visual distractions like hallways or doors. Place the desk/chair facing a calm natural window view.

luminous_envelope.name: Luminous Envelope
luminous_envelope.rule: Avoid harsh overhead lighting. Establish layered, highly focused pools of warm, low-level illumination strictly over active study or reading zones.

minimal_clutter.name: Minimal Clutter
minimal_clutter.rule: All horizontal storage must be enclosed. Out of sight, out of mind. Every intellectual book and tool has a closed cupboard address.

modular_delineation.name: Modular Delineation
modular_delineation.rule: Use multi-functional, flexible furniture (modular sectionals, nesting tables) to redefine the layout instantly based on current activity.

multi_axial.name: Multi-Axial Flow
multi_axial.rule: Create multiple diagonal and orthomorphic pathways through the room, allowing multiple activities to proceed side-by-side without interference.

adaptable_height.name: Adaptable Height
adaptable_height.rule: Incorporate height-adjustable tables and desks to allow seamless transitions from sitting focus to dynamic standing collaborative work.

kinetic_flow.name: Kinetic Flow
kinetic_flow.rule: Keep circulation pathways dynamic and wide, using rounded or organic furniture silhouettes to facilitate fluid kinetic movement through small spaces.
